entries.title: Zephyr Domain
entries.summary: Zephyr Wardens turn protection into speed, controlled flight, wind attacks, and mass aerial movement.
body: This is a converted specialization for [[sky-warden-class|Sky Warden]]. Choose it when the parent class grants its path or domain at 3rd level.

sections.heading: Converted path progression
body: Domain feature I — Windborn Blessing (3rd): Spend 1 skyward-energy point as a swift action. One creature within 30 feet gains +20-foot enhancement speed and +2 dodge AC against attacks of opportunity for 3 rounds.

Domain feature II — Gale Strike (7th): Spend 1 point when making or enabling a weapon attack. The attack deals +1d6 sonic damage and may make a bull rush using warden level + Wisdom modifier instead of Strength, without moving with the target.
Domain feature III — Zephyr's Embrace (11th): Spend 2 points to grant one willing creature within 30 feet a fly speed of 30 feet with average maneuverability for 5 rounds.

Domain feature IV — Windwalk (15th): Once per day, after 10 minutes of prayer, grant yourself and up to five creatures an overland fly speed of 60 feet with poor maneuverability for 1 hour per warden level. Combat ends the effect for that creature.

Domain feature V — Typhoon's Fury (19th): Spend 4 points as a standard action. Enemies in a 20-foot-radius burst within 60 feet take 10d6 sonic damage, are pushed 20 feet, and fall prone; a Fortitude save halves damage and negates movement and prone.

sections.heading: Use with the base class
body: The five features are gained at parent-class levels 3, 7, 11, 15, and 19 respectively.
Unless a feature states otherwise, save DC equals 10 + one-half parent-class level + the parent class’s key ability modifier.
This path does not replace the parent class’s base attack, saves, skills, resource pool, bonus feats, or core class features.

sourceRefs.notes: Converted five-stage specialization for the twenty-level parent class.

entries.title: Aether Domain
entries.summary: Aether Wardens specialize in temporary vitality, damage prevention, spell defense, and celestial protection.
body: This is a converted specialization for [[sky-warden-class|Sky Warden]]. Choose it when the parent class grants its path or domain at 3rd level.

sections.heading: Converted path progression
body: Domain feature I — Aetheric Blessing (3rd): Spend 1 point as a swift action to grant one creature within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to Wisdom modifier + one-half warden level for 5 rounds.

Domain feature II — Aether Shield (7th): Spend 2 points as an immediate action. One creature within 30 feet gains damage reduction 5/— and energy resistance 10 against all energy types until the start of the warden's next turn.
Domain feature III — Celestial Ward (11th): When an ally within 30 feet takes damage, spend 1 point as an immediate action to reduce that damage by warden level + Wisdom modifier.
Domain feature IV — Protective Aether (15th): Spend 2 points as a swift action. One willing creature within 30 feet gains +4 resistance on saves against spells and spell-like abilities for 5 rounds.

Domain feature V — Celestial Ascension (19th): Once per day for 5 rounds, the warden gains damage reduction 20/epic, energy resistance 30, and immunity to forced movement. Allies within 30 feet gain damage reduction 10/— and energy resistance 10.

entries.title: Stormcall Domain
entries.summary: Stormcall Wardens protect their crews by weaponizing thunder, lightning, motion, and retaliatory storm energy.
body: This is a converted specialization for [[sky-warden-class|Sky Warden]]. Choose it when the parent class grants its path or domain at 3rd level.

sections.heading: Converted path progression
body: Domain feature I — Thunderous Blessing (3rd): Spend 1 point as a swift action. One ally within 30 feet deals +1d6 sonic or electricity damage on the next successful weapon attack before the end of its next turn.

Domain feature II — Call of the Storm (7th): Spend 2 points as a standard action to strike one target within 60 feet for 1d6 electricity damage per two warden levels, maximum 10d6. A Reflex save halves damage.

Domain feature III — Thunderclap Aura (11th): Spend 2 points to activate a 10-foot hostile aura for 5 rounds. Enemies entering or starting in the aura take 2d6 sonic damage; a Fortitude save halves the damage. A creature saves only once per round.

Domain feature IV — Lightning Stride (15th): Spend 2 points as a swift action to move up to 60 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity. Creatures passed within 5 feet take 1d6 electricity damage per three warden levels, maximum 6d6, Reflex half.

Domain feature V — Stormlord's Wrath (19th): Once per day for 5 rounds, allies within 30 feet deal +1d6 sonic or electricity damage with weapon attacks, and creatures striking the warden in melee take 1d8 + Wisdom modifier sonic damage.
